I can do that — before I change anything, a few quick confirmations so I don’t make the wrong visible change:

Suggested default plan (tell me OK or edit):
- Target event: the “Design Review” meeting on your calendar (I’ll pick the existing event with that title).
- Which Friday: this coming Friday (if you mean a different Friday say “next Friday”).
- Time: Friday at 3:00–4:00 PM (a typical “Friday afternoon” slot). I will preserve the event’s current duration if you prefer that instead.
- Time zone: use the event’s current time zone unless you tell me otherwise.
- Invitations: I will send updated invites/updates to all current attendees. Tell me if you want anyone added/removed.
- Conferencing/location: keep the existing location/conference link unless you want me to change it.

Please confirm or tell me any changes (which Friday, a different time, change duration, add/remove attendees, change location/conference). Once you confirm I’ll reschedule and send the updates.
